question: What do sages obtain when doubt and difference knots are destroyed?
premises: devoted to welfare of all beings
inference: Liberation follows when the knots of difference and doubt are destroyed in restrained sages devoted to all beings.
uncertainties: compound brahmanirvāṇamṛṣayaḥ is read as sages attaining brahmanirvāṇa
plain_english: Sages obtain brahmanirvāṇa when their stains are worn away, duality is cut, selves are restrained, they are devoted to the welfare of all beings, and the two knots of difference and doubt are destroyed.
